ai.question: Is she likely to start a new patient on our therapy in the next 90 days?
ai.trainedOn: Two years of IQVIA prescriptions, claims counts, email engagement and call history, all already in Snowflake.
drivers: Peers in her practice already prescribing
ai.note: Dr O asked how her team should manage skin rash and colitis with immunotherapy in older patients. Wants something her infusion nurses can use.
ai.noteSource: Rep call note, Veeva CRM, 45 days ago
ai.ask: Which Texas oncologists raised side effect management this quarter but have not received the side effect guide?
ai.answer: 38 oncologists. 9 score above 0.7. Dr. Lena Ortiz ranks second.
ai.sql:
SELECT h.hcp_id, h.name, s.score
FROM gold.hcp h
JOIN ml.hcp_scores s USING (hcp_id)
JOIN ai.call_note_topics t USING (hcp_id)
WHERE h.state = 'TX'
  AND t.topic = 'Side effect management'
  AND h.hcp_id NOT IN (SELECT hcp_id FROM sfmc.sends
                       WHERE asset = 'side_effect_guide')
ORDER BY s.score DESC;

email.label: SFMC email
email.conn: Marketing Cloud connector to the brand's SFMC business unit
steps: The decision chooses the side effect guide email for Dr. Ortiz.
Data 360 writes her and the chosen fields (name, specialty, interest) into a shared data extension in SFMC.
Journey Builder uses it as its entry source. Sent at 10:42 from the oncology brand team.
Subject: "Managing immune related side effects: a guide for your team", with the approved guide and Important Safety Information.
email.back: Sends, opens and clicks flow back to Data 360 through the Marketing Cloud data stream, then on to Snowflake.

crm.label: Rep alert in CRM
crm.conn: API or a write back to Snowflake, then into Veeva CRM. Veeva is not a native Data 360 target.
steps: The decision plans a rep visit within 7 days.
The alert is written to Snowflake or sent through an API.
Her rep, Marcus Lee, sees: "Visit Dr. Ortiz this week. She downloaded the side effect guide today and asked about nurse support. Bring the nurse webinar invite."
He visits on Day 21 and logs the call.
crm.back: The call record returns in the nightly Veeva extract, lands in Snowflake, and updates her profile.

media.label: HCP media
media.conn: NPI list to HCP media publishers; hashed emails for social platforms
steps: The Side effect priority segment publishes as a list of NPIs.
The publisher matches NPIs to its verified HCP users.
Dr. Ortiz sees the approved side effect resource when she logs into a publisher site or app.
The publisher reports match rate and impressions as totals.
media.back: Results come back as aggregate reports, not as individual records.

rt.label: Real time triggers
rt.conn: Data Action targets: Salesforce Flow, platform events or SFMC journeys
steps: Dr. Ortiz downloads the side effect guide at 10:14.
The web tracking script streams the event into Data 360 within seconds.
A Data Action rule checks: side effect download, score at least 0.7, email consent.
It fires: the decision runs, the email goes at 10:42 and the rep alert appears the same day.
rt.back: This runs per event, not per segment publish.

web.label: Website
web.conn: Web tracking script plus Salesforce Personalization reading her live profile. Confirm the Personalization licence.
steps: Dr. Ortiz returns to the HCP website from the email link, so the site knows who she is.
As the page loads, Personalization asks Data 360 for her live profile.
It gets back: medical oncologist, interests efficacy and side effects, score 0.81.
The page leads with the side effect resources and the nurse webinar instead of the generic hero.
web.back: Nothing is sent ahead of time. The site asks about one person, at the moment she arrives. Her clicks stream back as new events.

outcomes.label: She opens the guide and registers for the webinar
rows: Rep visit with nurse webinar, as planned
outcomes.who: The model, at its next retrain in Snowflake: side effect content gains weight for oncologists like her.

outcomes.label: Rep dismisses the alert: "already covered"
rows: Side effect topics for Dr. Ortiz
outcomes.who: The rules, the same day. A dismiss reason is the cheapest training data there is, so capture it as a short pick list.

outcomes.label: No response to anything
outcomes.who: Both: the contact limit rule pauses her, and the model lowers her score at its next retrain.
